children: The following are significant news stories, press reports and events on Tuesday. ALL TIMES GMT (Poland: GMT + 2 hours):

On Tuesday, the Polish statistical office will release data on industrial production for September; according to analysts surveyed by Reuters, output grew by 3.1% year-on-year, following a 4.3% increase in August.
The market will also receive data on wage growth, which, according to economists, accelerated to 6.1% year-on-year in September, up from 5.6% the previous month.
Polish military police said on Monday they had detained a Polish-Ukrainian dual national suspected of spying who was attending an officer training course for reservists in the central city of Lodz.
